scope: Targeted native Mac visual review of HUD corrections, not a full game qualification.
reference_overrides: Owner requires resting weapon centres separated by half a disc diameter, active weapon in foreground, brief turn/depth exchange and attached shared Z footer.
Actual D097 equipment quality and missing equipment state override illustrative concept colours.
reuse_basis: HUD source is unchanged between v4 and v6; subsequent changes repair capture selection fixtures only.

checks.evidence: Thin circular borders, overlapping discs, active foreground and visible intermediate turn positions at all three sizes. Empty staff remains muted and switching footer disabled. No rectangular cyan selection frame.
Z · Сменить text is readable with clear interior space; former nine-slice rails no longer strike through the label.
Both complete descriptions render over subsequent card content, inside viewport, without clipped lines at 720/900/1080. Underlying content is intentionally covered by the tooltip overlay.
Actual selected barricade and workshop show no world or selected-card LVL. Upgradeable Rapid remains labelled in barricade frames.
Actual XP/level status, four preset buttons and feedback are readable in reviewed v4 debug frames at all three sizes.

return_history.issue: Capstone hover did not reach native tooltip repaint. Production hover hit test was changed to the existing CurrentGuiPointer route; final real hover frames pass.
Weapon footer used oversized generic nine-slice rails that crossed the Z label. Dedicated thin-slice footer fixes this in reviewed v4/v6.

capture_fixture_history: Earlier barricade capture assumed role 1; harness now discovers the nonattacking catalogue. This was a QA fixture issue, not a runtime visual defect.
Workshop capture initially hit the selected-barricade HUD strip. Clearing selection and framing the actual opaque workshop point resolved the QA fixture; final workshop frames pass.
limitations: Only the explicit 36 paths were visually reviewed; 102 is the complete capture count, not the review count.
Still frames establish endpoints and sampled turn geometry, not continuous temporal smoothness or a full manual gameplay/balance run.
All possible tooltip strings, input combinations and viewport aspect ratios are outside this targeted review.
Physical F10 preset clicks and focused test results are reported separately by the main agent; this report is visual evidence.
